decisions.reason: Because the accelerator remained prominently featured through 2024 and the firm is growing with enough slack to support ecosystem-building offers, management would keep it unless its indirect commercial benefits clearly fall short of aspirations.

The binder is still marketed in 2024, but as a more commercially uncertain and somewhat less core offering than the firm's machinery business it faces a higher risk of failing to meet aspiration levels, so management would keep it for now while monitoring results closely.

This decontamination plant is close to the firm's core capabilities, stayed on the home page in both years, and fits a growing innovative machinery firm that has the slack and incentive to continue a product that appears strategically aligned.
